procedure.en: With the grinder running, turn the collar finer until you hear a light chirping sound: that is where the burrs make contact. That point is your zero; count marks coarser from there. The printed 0 is not the zero.
procedure.pt-BR: Com o moedor ligado, gire o anel para o fino até ouvir um leve chiado: é onde as mós se tocam. Esse ponto é o seu zero; conte as marcas para o grosso a partir dali. O 0 impresso não é o zero.

notes: Stepless collar printed 0–90; values are marks from your own chirp zero, not from the printed 0. Variable speed 600–1800 RPM: changing RPM changes the particle distribution at a fixed gap, so published marks assume a fixed speed. No maker chart in the source; only Honest Coffee Guide. Honest Coffee Guide's computed slope is about 9.9 µm per mark ((1000 − 110) ÷ 90), a particle-size estimate, not burr travel. Review: brewcoffeehome.com/df64v-coffee-grinder-review/.
